transitions.fromZh: 纸袋仍留在门边，袋口未封
transitions.fromEn: The paper bag remains by the door, unsealed
transitions.toZh: 阿汐读出袋上的字，并把袋子留在原处
transitions.toEn: Axi reads the words on the bag and leaves it in place
transitions.narrativeZh: 阿汐读完「听留下」，没有等回应；纸袋仍留在门边。
transitions.narrativeEn: Axi reads “Listening remains” aloud and does not wait for a reply. The bag stays by the door.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 门缝送进一阵带盐味的风，字没有变化。
transitions.npcReactionEn: Salt-scented wind passes through the door slit; the words do not change.
transitions.atlasHookEn: Paper bag by the door: read the line aloud.

transitions.fromZh: 盐粒留在空秤盘中，尚未称量
transitions.fromEn: The grain of salt rests unweighed in the empty pan
transitions.toZh: 阿汐选择不称盐粒，也不将它移走
transitions.toEn: Axi chooses not to weigh or move the grain
transitions.narrativeZh: 盐粒留在秤盘上；阿汐不再追问它有多重。
transitions.narrativeEn: The grain stays on the pan; Axi no longer asks how much it weighs.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 渡人不催她称量，铜秤仍留在门槛。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The ferryman does not urge her to weigh it; the brass scale stays on the threshold.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 空秤盘：让盐粒留在原处。
transitions.atlasHookEn: Empty scale: leave the grain where it is.

transitions.fromZh: 门外的影子停在门槛前
transitions.fromEn: The shadow stands outside the threshold
transitions.toZh: 阿汐既不称量影子，也不追问它的来处
transitions.toEn: Axi neither weighs the shadow nor asks where it came from
transitions.narrativeZh: 影子仍可自行停留或离开；门没有被关上。
transitions.narrativeEn: The shadow remains free to stay or leave; the door is not closed.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 渡人不替阿汐决定是否让影子进门。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The ferryman does not decide for Axi whether the shadow may enter.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 门槛外的影子：不急着登记。
transitions.atlasHookEn: Shadow beyond the threshold: do not register it yet.

transitions.fromZh: 薄簿合着，未记的一页仍空白
transitions.fromEn: The thin ledger is closed; its unentered page remains blank
transitions.toZh: 阿汐合上薄簿，将它留在接缝旁
transitions.toEn: Axi closes the ledger and leaves it beside the floorboard seam
transitions.narrativeZh: 阿汐没有把干处或盐粒补进簿中；空页仍然空着。
transitions.narrativeEn: Axi does not enter the dry place or the grain of salt; the page stays blank.
transitions.npcReactionZh: 薄页不再需要她替它记下每一件事。
transitions.npcReactionEn: The page no longer needs her to record everything for it.
transitions.atlasHookZh: 未记之页：合上薄簿，保留空白。
transitions.atlasHookEn: Unentered page: close the ledger and leave it blank.

atlasDraft.pZh: 船仍停在门外，船底那道浅痕没有被潮水带走。阿汐没有去摸。薄簿合着，秤盘空着。天亮时，门槛上的盐粒少了一粒；没有人知道它去了哪里。
atlasDraft.pEn: The boat remained outside. The faint mark beneath its hull had not been taken by the tide. Axi did not touch it. The ledger stayed closed; the scale pan stayed empty. At dawn, one grain of salt was missing from the threshold. No one knew where it had gone.
atlasDraft.codaZh: 有些空处，不因少了一粒而变大。
atlasDraft.codaEn: Some empty spaces do not grow when a grain is gone.
